description: Every year Swedish district heating companies report data on their distribution activity, and on production and trading when the same company also produces or trades heat, to the Swedish Energy Markets Inspectorate (Ei), which compiles and publishes them. The technical data for 2019 to 2024 come as Excel files by price area: distribution in the network, with investments in networks and substations, operation and maintenance costs, network pipe length, interruptions and network age; delivered heat, with customer and delivery point numbers at the start and end of the year by customer type, heat sold and revenues from connection fees and heat; production, with heat produced, production investments and fuel types; and a special report on heat and electricity delivered within and outside the company group. A PDF explains the reported items. Ei uses the data for supervision and for efficiency and quality indicators, and updates the statistics yearly, usually in October to November; the page was reviewed on 13 October 2025. Coverage is Sweden. Files are free under Ei open data terms. Caveats: figures are company self-reports aggregated per price area, not network geometry. Simulation uses are benchmarking district heating network size, age and interruption rates and heat supply mixes for planning. Related records: data-energiforetagen-sweden-district-heating-statistics gives industry statistics.
